agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch changes the logic to add a persistent `last_extent` flag and, after `f2fs_migrate_blocks()`, always `goto retry` with the comment `/* lookup block mapping info after block migration */`, while the CVE description says the old code “incorrectly assumes this is the last extent ... intent_record.intent_summary: Always retry block mapping lookup after migration to use refreshed mapping information.

intent_record.how: This change makes the code always retry the lookup path in this case instead of only retrying when `last_extent` is false. At runtime, it forces the function to re-evaluate block mapping information after block migration, ensuring it uses updated mapping state rather than potentially proceeding with stale data.
